verdict.rationale: Feitian offers GUI tools (SK Manager, iePassManager, OTP Tool) for managing FIDO/PIV/OTP functions, PINs, and slots, but these are graphical utilities, not documented as scriptable CLIs. No evidence of a command-line interface, scripting API, or automation-friendly tooling for enabling apps, setting PINs, or reading device state. missing for 10: dedicated CLI tool, scripting/automation documentation, examples of headless/scriptable configuration workflows.
